chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hafs ibn Suqat, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the man who plays with his wife or his slave girl, and he is making up a fast of the month of Ramadan, so his water descends and he ejaculates, he said: Upon him is the expiation similar to what is upon the one who copulates during the month of Ramadan.

key_terms.قَضَاءُ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: Making up the fast of Ramadan
key_terms.يُلَاعِبُ: Plays with / engages in playful intimacy

ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for ejaculating during playful intimacy while fasting in Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that pre-ejaculation (sabq al-ma') during playful intimacy while making up a Ramadan fast incurs the same major expiation (kaffarah) as full intercourse, a ruling derived from the principle of equality in breaking the fast's sanctity. It highlights the juristic consensus that the specific act of intercourse is not the sole determinant for the heavy penalty, but rather the act of breaking the fast deliberately through sexual release. This ruling is particularly significant in Shia fiqh for distinguishing between minor breaks and those requiring the full kaffarah of freeing a slave, fasting two consecutive months, or feeding sixty poor people.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hafs Bin Sowqat, from the one who mentioned it,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the man who played with his wife, or his slave girl, and it was during the making up of a Fast of the Month of Ramazan, so his water descended. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon him would be the expiation similar to what is upon the one who copulates during the Month of Ramazan’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hafs ibn Sawqah from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who plays with his wife or slave-girl while fasting for Qada’ (compensatory fast) of the month of Ramadan until semen discharge takes place.
He (the Imam) said, ‘Its expiation is like that for having sexual intercourse in the month of Ramadan.’”
